These pages were the first deployment experiments for the course site. They tested hosted `marimo.app` iframes, locally exported WASM notebooks, shared assets, eager loading, and fullscreen behavior. They are kept so implementation decisions remain traceable; the current L01 and L02 pages are the student-facing lectures.

- [Archived L01 · editable marimo embedding comparison](L01-embed-comparison.qmd)
- [Archived L02 · two local marimo playgrounds](L02-local-playgrounds.qmd)

The archive is not part of the Fall 2026 lecture sequence.
